professionalSummary: Senior Data Scientist with four years of experience in credit decisioning, owning and validating application scorecards.
Master’s degree in Statistics with a strong quantitative foundation.
Proven leadership in supervising data scientists and presenting models to credit risk committees.
Expertise in documenting model limitations and monitoring boundaries.
experienceHighlights: Model owner of record for two application scorecards that passed independent validation in 2023 and 2025, with signature on model documentation.
Supervised two data scientists on scorecard rebuilds, reviewing feature work and test plans before validation submissions.
Presented scorecards to the credit risk committee at approval and annual review, with minutes recorded.
Authored model limitation and monitoring boundary sections for each scorecard, updated annually.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Signed model documentation for a 2025 scorecard with validation sign-off page and committee minutes extract.
Degree certificate (MSc Statistics, 2017) as verification of educational background.
